summary: Owner-approved artifact update for native run_ticks(count) exports. The export removes repeated JavaScript-to-Wasm crossings when a frame or host advances more than one generation; state-transition work remains entirely native and output parity is unchanged.
cause: World, WorldK, WorldStochastic, and WorldHcp each gain one thin run_ticks(count) export. The default and stochastic Wasm payloads compress smaller despite the export; generated glue grows by 56 and 48 gzip bytes respectively. HCP grows by 52 gzip bytes total. The solid artifact is byte-identical because it has no tick engine. The root/CA bundle measurements also cover dirty rendering, fixed-point parking, and batched wrapper logic. Symmetry is a pre-existing unrecorded baseline drift found when the audit was made exhaustive; it measured 2681 gzip bytes before this work and is unchanged by it.
